name: Slovak FMC Nationals 2024

venue.name: [Farský kostol sv. Don Bosca (Trnávka)](https://trnavka.sk/)
venue.details: Entrance through gate at Staničná and Nerudova street crossing.

information:
[SK]
Táto súťaž je Majstrovstvami Slovenska v kategórií FMC, ktorá nebola na [Majstrovstvách Slovenska 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SlovakNationals2024). Táto súťaž je organizovaná občianskym združením [Speedcubing Slovakia](https://speedcubingslovakia.sk)!

[EN]
This competition is a National Championship in FMC, which is the only event not contested at our [National Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SlovakNationals2024). This competition is organized by [Speedcubing Slovakia](https://speedcubingslovakia.sk)!
